summary: Recommends Kerberos for domain environments (supports delegation and HTTP message encryption), notes extra control-node setup is required, and shows host vars for psrp and winrm.
questions: How do I configure Kerberos authentication for Windows hosts in Ansible?
What username format do I use for Kerberos with WinRM?
How do I stop psrp from falling back to NTLM?

answer_card.title: Using Kerberos auth with WinRM
answer_card.answer_md:
Kerberos is recommended in domains: it supports credential delegation and message encryption over HTTP. It needs extra setup on the Ansible host (see `windows_winrm_kerberos`).

```yaml
ansible_user: username@MY.DOMAIN.COM
ansible_password: Password
ansible_connection: psrp
ansible_psrp_auth: negotiate   # or kerberos to disable NTLM fallback
# winrm:
ansible_winrm_transport: kerberos
```
